content:
alex: paging: spike in 5xx from runtime pool us-west-1 at 17:03 UTC. Errors are TIMEOUT / queue-shed. inbound QPS normal but tail latency skyrocketed. :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-493 created by alex @channel

maria: oncall, are we routing to fallback models? any auto-fallback triggers?

paul: we saw queue depth > 1200 on node set r-runtime-*-gw. max_in_flight hit 512, queueing kicked in then timeouts.

alex: confirming max_in_flight was recently bumped for a canary. I'll revert to 256 to test.

paul: do not restart pods yet. We should try shaping first: apply token bucket rate limit for non-critical tenants.

liz: which tenants are non-critical? list?

paul: list: sketchapp, demo-corp, int-tests. I'll push a temp quota-limiter to throttle them to 30rps each.

alex: doing quota change via admin API now:

```
POST /admin/quota/tenants/limit
{\"tenant\": \"sketchapp\", \"rps\": 30, \"until\": \"2026-03-15T18:30:00Z\"}
```

ops-bot: Quota update queued. Change ID q-1930456789-1

maria: also toggling prefix-KV cache bypass for demos — that reduces CPU but increases token work, tradeoff noted.

alex: hit apply rate limits and reduce max_in_flight on gateway to 256 now.

paul: confirmed gateway config patched: max_in_flight=256, shedding_policy=reject_after_queue_200, timeout_ms=12000

incident-bot: config-change recorded: cfg-apply-1930456789-2 by alex

maria: customer impact check: we have ~8 customers reporting errors; only 1 (enterprise-acme) on Dedicated with SLA. Their requests are routed to fallback model 1. Enterprise-acme latency at 700ms and occasional 503s.

alex: notify acct team - I'll open a brief incident update to them.

alex: acct-team @here Enterprise-acme degraded; using fallback. Estimated impact 15% of their requests. Sending email.

liz: monitoring: 5xx rate dropped 60% after quota and max_in_flight change. Queue depth down to 210.

paul: good. but CPU on r-runtime-05 jumped — maybe cache misses. consider increasing kv-cache ttl back for critical tenants.

maria: doing that for enterprise-acme only.

```
POST /admin/cache/policy
{\"tenant\":\"enterprise-acme\",\"ttl_sec\":3600}
```

ops-bot: Cache policy change applied: cache-1930456790

alex: oncall handoff incoming in 30m — maria, if it keeps trending we should plan a graceful fallback to model-small for non-SLA traffic and enable request-drops for demo/test tenants.

maria: copy. I'll prepare the script to scale down worker concurrency too.

paul: note: avoid full disable of passthrough. prefer 503-shedding with Retry-After header set to 30s so clients can backoff.

liz: creating followup ticket with actions: rollback canary, tenant throttles, cache tweak, monitor dashboards. ticket INF-3127

alex: closing the loop — current status: mitigations applied, visible improvement, still monitoring. Will escalate if errors creep back above 5%.

incident-bot: INC-2026-493 status: mitigated -> monitoring

maria: taking handoff at 18:00 UTC. alex, leave any outstanding notes in the ticket.

alex: done. notes added: q-1930456789-1, cfg-apply-1930456789-2, cache-1930456790, INF-3127

liz: thumbs. I'll keep alerting until metrics stable for 45m.

paul: FYI, we should add a safety limit to future canary config changes to avoid >400 max_in_flight without a gated rollout.

maria: agreed — will add to postmortem runbook.

alex: TY all. :thumbsup:
